panel_source: Private existing ChatGPT conversation /c/6ae05018-6ce4-83ec-842a-1f21e1aa548b, same original anonymous display PNG; no author pixels rehosted

panel_reverification.hash_method: SHA-256 over decoded original data URL PNG bytes, browser crypto.subtle
panel_reverification.access: connected Opera Neon, original ChatGPT conversation

method.comparison: crop primary Chinese wordmarks from existing panel; same displayed glyph ink height 140 px
method.source_pixel_threshold: RGB all channels <130 considered dark ink, mask applied to panel pixels, not to the original designer images
method.count_rule: Dark pixels counted inside bounding rectangle; density=dark_count/(bbox width*bbox height); x-projection group count is not glyph count
method.preview: 64px height Canvas downsample; 32px auxiliary preview visually reviewed; neither is human legibility proof

derived_comparisons.note: Numeric ratios are measured geometry, not design-quality scores or evidence of incorrect Chinese writing

nonblind_design_notes.甲: Compact geometric handwriting/lettering language with strong regularity. Higher area ink density and letter structural reduction create a plausible small-size readability risk, especially where internal counters and semantic components are compressed. Not proof of a wrong character.
nonblind_design_notes.乙: Looser width, calligraphic or carved-stroke language with stronger differentiating gesture. At 32px anti-aliased preview, thin or broken brushstroke details soften; must test real usage rather than treating expressive irregularity as an automatic advantage.

audit_limitations: The assistant's session already encountered the author's historic customer-choice text; it is not an independent blind aesthetic judge.

The prior private display was thresholded from designer originals at luminosity 184; source panel pixel geometry must not be misrepresented as original compressed image bytes or hand-drawn vector paths.
No independent human glyph recognition was obtained; neither candidate can be declared correct/incorrect from geometry counts.
At the same ink height, different widths and darkness are actual design characteristics, not equalized; these differences may affect human preference.
Textual visual diagnosis is post hoc; it cannot validate generalization to unseen Chinese words, logo contexts, or future clients.
The locally self-tested Python replay utility exists as a local conversation artifact but has NOT been run on the private source PNG in the container; browser measurement is the actual source result.
next_action: Preserve original anonymous mapping; obtain genuine independent human glyph + preference result if available, otherwise do not block on it: use these nonblind diagnostics as failure hypotheses only, and evaluate a different unseen Chinese-word design in a new genuinely independent experiment with permission and equal budget.
